Use case: illustration-story. Create one complete literary-room companion mother artwork, exactly 1536 × 1024 pixels, horizontal full canvas. No other character image, pose image or face is supplied.

Gentle, perceptive, with a little self-possession and warmth. No broad interchangeable grin, hostess pose, exaggerated sadness, pleading, pointing or celebratory gesture. No written speech or caption.

Identity entirely from text: Soyo Nagasaki / 長崎そよ, BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!. Faithful youthful Japanese 2D anime identity, long natural LIGHT BROWN hair, softly curved side locks and gently curled ends, fine airy bangs, clear BLUE eyes and a delicate youthful observant face. Her hair is light brown rather than blonde, gray, pink or Sakiko's blue. BOTH eyes and their fine linework remain clear and visible; bangs frame the eyes naturally instead of hiding either eye. Faithful Tsukinomori school uniform: dark NAVY sailor blouse with a broad WHITE sailor collar and fine navy trim, a gray-blue bow with small GOLD school crest at the throat, dark navy pleated knee-length skirt with TWO white lines near its hem, dark knee socks and simple BROWN loafers. Keep her clothing's own navy/white colors, youthful ordinary proportions and modest fully clothed school-day presence. No mature model styling, chibi proportions, borrowed face or another character's uniform.

Basic supported posture: she sits on the actual linen window bench near the round table, her hips and thighs resting with believable weight on the cushion. Leave the lamp, cup and tabletop intact and the left writing desk visible. Her torso sits upright and gently turns toward the off-camera companion near the viewer, shoulders settled, no leaning toward the lens. A thin, nearly closed booklet lies across her own lap; both hands rest lightly on it, with one relaxed fingertip at its page edge, an ordinary unforced small gesture. The booklet has faint abstract paper texture without readable content. Show clear wrist-to-arm connections and natural fingers without hiding an error behind the book. Her legs are comfortably arranged with real continuous hip-to-knee-to-ankle relations. Both complete brown loafers rest a little forward on the clear floor, with subtle contact shadows and believable perspective. The bench front remains behind her lower legs, the cushion supports her weight, and no limb penetrates the furniture. No extra limb, fused knee/hand, missing shoe or floating unsupported body. Do not force a decorative leg pose.

This is the newly selected close-room HUMAN scale: full seated figure, hair top approximately y=110 and complete shoe soles approximately y=880–900 on the 1536×1024 canvas. Keep the feet naturally forward on the floor so the full figure reaches this near-room scale; do not obtain it by enlarging her head, leaning into camera, stretching the shins, shrinking furniture, changing the room camera or cropping the body. Her hair, both hands, skirt, knees, ankles and both shoes are all within the frame, with clear breathing room. The figure feels physically present beside the original side table and bench rather than small and distant.

Apricot clear-day atmosphere: almond-gold window light stays on the wood and porcelain, gently picks up her light-brown hair and fingertips, and leaves nuanced soft shadow planes on her face. Preserve clear blue eyes, warm natural skin and clean navy/white local colors. Match her lighting, contact shadows and occlusion to this same room without gray/gold overlays or a sticker outline. Refined anime linework and softly modeled anime shading coexist naturally with the detailed literary-room illustration. One complete coherent scene, no interface, collage, borders, logos, watermark, captions or artificial fog.
